about: Known-item queries for bench.js. Targets: 60 questions sampled with a fixed seed, stratified by game. recall = a few words someone remembering the question would type (inflection may differ); paraphrase = the idea in other words, few shared content words. ascii/typo variants and answer-lookup queries are generated by bench.js.
